senses.gloss: m. (נָקַר I; cmp. מוֹקְרָא II) [marrow,] the white heart or terminal bud of a palm (cabbage tree) used as food.
units: Ukts. III, 7 הק׳ הרי הוא כעץ וכ׳ ḳor is like wood in every respect (not susceptible of levitical uncleanness), but may be bought for tithe-money (being considered as food); Tosef. ib. III, 10; Y. Shebi. IV, end, 35ᶜ; Erub. 28ᵇ.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 3:21">Tosef. Shebi. III, 21</cite>; a. e.
